items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What, what, what was his, I don't know who that is, who is he, what did he play?

ctx.x: Yeah. And, um, would any of the musicians ever come round to your house, can you remember any of the musicians that he used to play with or anything?

Well, I know, I know a good bit of them, but now since, you know, they spread away, you know? Yes. George Lewis, he went across the river. Yeah. The other fellas Hank and then, they went uptown. Hank?
